description: This file defines the MySQLi class for database interactions in the Opencart system, including connection setup with SSL options, query execution, and connection management.

classes.name: MySQLi
classes.description: A class encapsulating MySQLi database connection and query operations, including SSL setup, query execution, and connection management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MySQLi connection with provided options, including SSL setup and session configuration.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query and returns a result object or boolean, with detailed error handling.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe SQL usage.

methods.name: countAffected
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last query.

methods.name: getLastId
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted auto-increment ID.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the database connection is active.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Closes the database connection and cleans up SSL temporary files.
